title: Home Assistant for LAN control of the Viomi V3 robot vacuum
objective: Deploy Home Assistant on the PC (Docker, host networking, pinned image) with the hass-xiaomi-miot integration so viomi.vacuum.v13 can be started and docked over the LAN from a FOSS UI, and open tcp/8123 to the LAN and wg0 only through the existing single-source-of-truth firewall script. Success: start and dock work from the Home Assistant Android app on the Pixel 6a, and setup_wireguard_ssh.sh verify passes.
acceptance_criteria: setup_homeassistant.sh setup is idempotent and ends with the HA API answering on 127.0.0.1:8123
setup_homeassistant.sh status reports container, API, xiaomi_miot version and the 8123 firewall rule
setup_wireguard_ssh.sh allow-homeassistant persists ALLOW_HOMEASSISTANT and renders exactly two 8123 accept rules (LAN subnet, wg0)
setup_wireguard_ssh.sh verify passes on the host after the change
out_of_scope: Exposing Home Assistant to the internet
verifier: vmbox run of allow-homeassistant + verify; host setup_wireguard_ssh.sh verify; setup_homeassistant.sh setup/status; on-device start/dock from the HA companion app
